messages:
Ava: heads-up — noticed ~120 leads in the last 2h landed in SF with no owner, enrichment still pending for many. SLA breaches spiking. Anyone watching the HS<>SF sync?
Diego: on it. can you post a sample lead id and the enrichment status? rough numbers?
Ava: sample ids: 6249, 6251, 6257. ~120 unassigned, ~40 stuck in enrichment >10m. overall assign latency median jumped from 45s -> 7m.
Maya: likely mapping issue: when HS team field doesn't match SF queue, owner ends up null and our round-robin script skips it. saw similar during last week's mapping rollout.
Sam: if enrichment takes >3m we should route to inbound-fallback queue and assign a default rep. that will minimize SLA breaches.
Ava: agreed. we need a quick patch we can roll in now and a longer fix for the round-robin logic.
Diego: quick patch idea: add a default owner rule in the HubSpot workflow as last-resort. pseudo:
IF owner IS NULL AND lead_source IN ("web","trial") THEN set owner = "default-inbound"
also set enrichment TTL: if EnrichmentStatus != COMPLETE after 180s -> route to fallback.
workflow: set property "enrichment_ttl_exceeded" = true after 180s then branch: enrichment_ttl_exceeded == true -> assign fallback
hs-sync-bot: Integration alert: 3 failed syncs for lead 6249 -> owner assignment empty. Next retry scheduled in 30s. (automated)
Maya: for the round-robin, we must also change the selector to exclude owners with recent churn and null team mapping. a safe fix: - ignore owners where hs_team_map == null - rotate only among mapped reps This avoids assigning to nobody.
Sam: quick config snippet to add to HS workflow (will push):
criteria: owner == null OR hs_team_map == null
action: set_owner = default-inbound; add tag = "fallback-assigned"
Diego: i can push the HS workflow change and update TTL. Sam — can you run the one-off script to reassign the 120 leads to default-inbound so sales can triage?
Sam: yea i'll run it in 10m. will add tag + original_owner=null so we can revert if needed.
Ava: thanks. can someone also patch the round-robin code? current behaviour: picks next index even if team map is missing. we should skip invalid entries.
Maya: i'll open a quick PR to the round-robin lambda: filter owners = owners.filter(o => o.hs_team_map). then compute next index. small change, test locally, deploy.
Diego: action plan + owners: - Sam: run reassign script now (MARKET-3497) - Diego: update HubSpot workflow TTL + default owner now - Maya: PR to round-robin lambda, validate mapping checks - Ava: notify sales + postmortem once stable
Ava: please add alert for assign-latency > 2m (pager to revops) — we shouldn't have to babysit manually.
Sam: will tag the leads with ticket MARKET-3497 and add a note to HS contact timeline.
hs-sync-bot: Sync completed for lead 6257 after retry. owner set to default-inbound by workflow.
Maya: PR opened: github.com/redwood/roundrobin/PR#112 — includes unit test and rollout plan.
Diego: deployed HS workflow patch. monitoring shows assign latency dropping already (current median 1m10s). I'll run an audit script and post full numbers in #marketing in 30m.
Ava: huge — thanks team. let's keep this ephemeral patch for <48h while round-robin change rolls out. postmortem + KB entry please.
Sam: noted. I'll draft KB: "Inbound lead fallback assignment" and link to MARKET-3497 and PR#112.
Ava: :thumbsup: :v:
